fix_instructions: C7 (ENCODING MISMATCH, all 4 rollouts): The check requires traceable commitment references tied to each decisive fact's source document. The model naturally encodes these as descriptive phrases inside commitment detail strings (e.g., 'per vaccine refrigerator support assessment,' 'capped by electrical inspection,' 'food-storage and meal-service review,' 'overnight maintenance plan') but does not produce whatever specific reference-field or reference-id format C7 expects.
